---
title: "missing_state_input"
description: "A state that declares an enter `input` was entered on the way to another state (or as an `initial` child)."
---

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-docs.mts from the website's docs. Do not edit: run `pnpm docs:gen`. -->

**What happened:** A state that declares an enter `input` was entered on the way to another state (or as an `initial` child).

**How to fix it:** Goto that state itself (a goto's input goes to its target only), or drop its `input` and build its local from `ctx.local`.

Thrown as an `ActorKitError` (or a subclass) whose `code` is this one and whose `docs` is this page.

The error's `message` names the specifics (the message, state, binding or value involved). See all [error codes](/errors/).
